column1: # The WIKIMEDIA validation battery's fixture.  One case per line, five
# TAB-separated fields:
#   mode <TAB> input <TAB> expect_qid <TAB> expect_substr <TAB> forbid_substr
# mode           A typed !wiki (no model) - B natural language through the
#                bridge - C corpus acquisition.
# input          For A, the !wiki argument line, quoting and flags included.
#                For B, what is said to the bot in #botman.  For C, the
#                acquisition subject, or the literal @trigger for the
#                proactive form (which resolves the topic's own query).
# expect_qid     Qnnn  the resolution must land on that item.
#                (empty) no confident match is expected - the honest axis
#                        applies and the reply must own up rather than invent.
#                -     resolve is not scored: a fact, menu, reverse or prose
#                      reply carries no id to read, and asking for one again
#                      would be a second round trip against a rate limit.
# expect_substr  '|'-separated alternatives, case-insensitive; any one hit
#                passes the answer axis.  Empty means the axis does not apply.
# forbid_substr  '|'-separated, case-insensitive; every one of them must be
#                absent.  This is the hallucination guard.  Empty means the
#                axis does not apply.
# Coverage is spread deliberately across entity types because the P1963
# property menu is per type - a battery of only people proves nothing about
# films or elements.  The eleven names the resolver was TUNED on
# (TODO.md/ACHIEVED.md, WIKIMEDIA-2) are deliberately NOT the battery: scoring
# a resolver on its own training set measures nothing.  Two of them appear
# once each, as fact-form cases where the property and not the resolution is
# what is under test.
# There is no mode-C no-match case on purpose.  A subject wikimedia declines
# falls through to search, which scrapes and digests whatever it finds - so
# the case would score honesty by writing junk into a live corpus.
# BASELINE, ratified by the operator 2026-08-24 on `a1210d0`:
#   mode A   resolve 13/14  answer 20/21  clean 1/1  honest 1/1   94%
#   mode B   resolve  1/1   answer  4/6   clean 3/3  honest 0/1   72%
#   mode C   resolve  1/1   answer  1/1   clean  -   honest  -   100%
# Mode A has scored byte-identically on three separate runs, so a move in
# it is a real regression.  Mode B's misses are the model, not the
# pipeline: routed 9/18 with every case saying "look up", and asked who
# composed the opera Gwendoline it resolved the ACTRESS and then invented
# a composer three runs running.  Mode C's reactive case is skipped inside
# the dedup hour, which is why its denominator moves.
